name: To The Shore's End
source:
"My shadow shrinks to nothing, then it recoils as if noon had come twice."

I feel utterly lost here, in this world.
[spoiler]With you.[/spoiler]
But you give us a purpose—the beach. You smile when you extend your hand to me.
[spoiler]How much of it is true? I’d know, but alas, the truth escapes my grasp.[/spoiler]
Still, we go, hand in hand, in spite of the world’s silence.
[spoiler]Silence filled with despair and withered flowers.[/spoiler]
Who knows what we’ll encounter, but regardless, we’ll face it with a smile.
[spoiler]Even when those lips are wet with cascading tears.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://passiv-boi.itch.io/to-the-shores-end]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我的影子缩小到什么都没有，然后又缩回去，就像中午来了两次一样。”

我感到完全迷失在这里，在这个世界上。
[spoiler]和你在一起。[/spoiler]但你给了我们一个目标——海滩。当你向我伸出手时，你微笑着。
[spoiler]有多少是真的？我知道，但可惜，事实却逃不过我的掌握。[/spoiler]尽管世界一片寂静，我们仍然手拉手前行。
[spoiler]沉默，充满绝望和枯萎的花朵。[/spoiler]谁知道我们会遇到什么，但无论如何，我们都会微笑面对。
[spoiler]即使双唇被泪水打湿。[/spoiler]

[来自[url=https://passiv-boi.itch.io/to-the-shores-end]Itch.io[/url]]
